name: Case does not exist: a sensor disappears
name_fr: La casse n'existe pas : un capteur disparaît

origin.campaign: August 2026 — observation campaign, verdicts on scripts and on rare genres (2026-08-08)

seen.excerpt: Devanagari, Thai, Arabic, Hangul, Han, Kana carry no case. Every rule that leans on a capital to mark a proper noun or the start of a sentence falls to zero. It is not an added difficulty: it is a sensor that disappears — and code that was measured on Latin script cannot see that it has lost it. The symmetric case, worse, is in Latin script: a Danish journal whose running head reads « d e r  v o l l k o MMe n e  c a Pe l l Me is Te r ». There the signal was missing; here it lies.
seen.reserve: observation cited from the August campaign; the documents of that wave were not kept by identifier, so this form has no reproducible example yet

prevention.refusal_clause: declare the script of the document and disable every case-dependent rule outside the scripts that carry case, rather than letting it return nothing

repair.note: nothing to delete: the graph is simply empty where the rule was blind; derived from the damage class by the migration of 2026-09-09, not judged form by form and not measured — the bench can measure it

measured.source: measured 2026-09-10 by pgrepair (SciPyWeightedILP) on the frozen EUR-Lex truth, three identical runs, journal sha256 in measures/reachability-by-damage-2026-09-10.json. Per damage class, not per form: two forms of the same damage and the same visibility get the same answer.

history.event: created from the August 2026 verdicts on scripts and on rare genres, which the atlas had never carried

proposed_severity.reason: no case in the writing system: every rule leaning on a capital goes blind and lets proper nouns through
proposed_severity.status: proposed — a second reader confirms or contests, as for the 43 validated forms
proposed_severity.note: this reading agrees with how the August catalogue judges most MISSING forms (G3), so it adds little
